about: A command line tool that moves data between files and databases.

prs.title: Times loaded into SQLite keep their time zone
prs.broken: Loading timestamps with a time zone offset into SQLite dropped the offset and labelled them UTC. Every time was off by its offset.
prs.changed: I made the loader write the real offset, and still write UTC times as before.
prs.matters: Order and event times from other zones land in SQLite at the right moment.
